title: Cat Rests Helps Owner Play Piano
description: A cat decided that his owners lap was his favorite place to sit as the owner plays the piano. The cat moves slightly so that the hands can reach the keys needed in the song, but otherwise it is not planning on going anywhere. Perhaps it likes the song after all.
